qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Prosus is an investment holding company whose asset value and look-through earnings are overwhelmingly concentrated in non-Western emerging markets (specifically Tencent in China via offshore VIE structures, Swiggy in India, and iFood in Brazil) lacking rule-of-law Western property rights.
qualitative.evidence: Over 70% of Prosus NAV and equity-accounted earnings stem from Tencent Holdings in China. Consolidated operating FCF conversion is extremely low (~8% of GAAP net income) due to non-cash associate earnings. Capital allocation history outside Tencent includes catastrophic capital destruction (e.g., 100% write-off of $500M+ Byju's investment, $1.8B acquisition of Stack Overflow).
